## SidebarNav.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `items` :: The navigation tree: links, groups and separators.
- `current` :: The current page's href, used to set `aria-current`.
- `collapsed` :: Whether the rail is icon-only. Two-way bindable; its width springs between states.
- `onCollapsedChange` :: Called whenever the rail is collapsed or expanded.
- `shortcut` :: Keyboard shortcut letter paired with `Cmd`/`Ctrl` to toggle collapse (or `false` to disable).
- `mobileOpen` :: Open state on narrow/mobile viewports where the sidebar presents as a slide-over drawer; bindable.
- `label` :: Accessible name of the navigation.
- `size` :: The height of the count badge beside an item.
- `shape` :: The corner treatment of that badge.
- `childTextSize` :: The scale of the badge's number.
- `surface` :: The rail's own surface: fill, border, rim and shadow together. @default 'elevated'

## items.ts

### `interface SidebarItem`

One entry in a SidebarNav tree: a link, a collapsible group, or a separator.

- `label` :: The visible label. Omit it on a separator.
- `href` :: A destination. Items with `children` are groups and ignore this.
- `icon` :: An icon drawn before the label.
- `badge` :: A short badge or count, drawn after the label.
- `children` :: Nested items; when present, this entry is a collapsible group.
- `disabled` :: Prevents the item from being followed or opened.
- `separator` :: Renders a hairline separator instead of a link or a group.
- `defaultOpen` :: When this is a group, whether it starts open. Groups that contain the current page start open anyway.
